servicesPage.intro: At Dallas Plumbing Pros Service, we offer a full range of plumbing services for residential and commercial customers in Dallas, TX. From emergency repairs to installations, our experienced team delivers quality workmanship and exceptional customer care.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.shortDescription: 24/7 emergency service for burst pipes, leaks, and more.
services.longDescription: When plumbing disasters strike, you need a plumber who responds fast. Our emergency team is available 24/7, including holidays. We’ll diagnose the issue, stop the damage, and provide lasting repairs. Common emergencies include burst pipes, overflowing toilets, water heater failures, and sewer backups.
benefits: No extra charge for after-hours calls
Fully equipped trucks for on-the-spot repairs

process.title: Call & Dispatch
process.description: Call our emergency line and a friendly dispatcher will send the nearest technician to your location immediately.

process.title: Diagnosis & Estimate
process.description: Our plumber arrives, assesses the problem, and provides a clear estimate before any work begins.

process.title: Repair & Cleanup
process.description: We complete the repair efficiently, clean up the work area, and ensure everything is functioning properly.

faqs.question: Do you charge extra for emergency calls?
faqs.answer: No, we keep our rates the same regardless of the time of day or day of the week. You only pay for the service, not the hour.

faqs.question: How quickly can you get to my home?
faqs.answer: We aim to arrive within 30 minutes for emergency calls within the Dallas metro area.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Clog Removal
services.shortDescription: Clear drains and prevent future clogs with advanced techniques.
services.longDescription: Slow drains, gurgling sounds, and foul odors are signs of a clog. We use hydro-jetting and video inspection to thoroughly clean your drains and identify underlying issues. Our methods are safe for your pipes and effective against even tough blockages like grease and tree roots.

process.title: Inspection
process.description: We insert a camera into the drain to locate the clog and assess pipe condition.

process.title: Clearing
process.description: Using a drain snake or hydro-jetter, we break up and flush away the blockage.

process.title: Final Check
process.description: We run water and re-inspect to confirm the drain is clear and flowing freely.

faqs.question: Is hydro-jetting safe for old pipes?
faqs.answer: Yes, hydro-jetting uses controlled pressure that is safe for most pipe materials, including PVC and cast iron.

faqs.question: How often should I have my drains cleaned?
faqs.answer: We recommend professional drain cleaning every 12-18 months to prevent buildup and avoid emergencies.

services.title: Water Heater Services
services.shortDescription: Installation, repair, and maintenance for all water heater types.
services.longDescription: Whether you need a new water heater installed or an existing one repaired, our team handles it all. We work with tank and tankless models from leading brands. Our services include diagnosis of no hot water, strange noises, leaks, and routine maintenance to extend the life of your unit.

process.title: Assessment
process.description: We evaluate your current system and discuss your hot water needs to recommend the best solution.

process.title: Installation or Repair
process.description: Our technicians perform the work efficiently, ensuring all connections are secure and up to code.

process.title: Testing & Guidance
process.description: We test the system, show you how to operate it, and provide maintenance tips.

faqs.question: How long does a water heater last?
faqs.answer: Traditional tank water heaters last 8-12 years, while tankless models can last 20+ years with proper maintenance.

faqs.question: What size water heater do I need?
faqs.answer: It depends on your household size and usage. We’ll help you calculate the right capacity during our assessment.

services.title: Fixture Installation & Repair
services.shortDescription: Professional installation and repair of faucets, toilets, sinks, and more.
services.longDescription: Upgrade your home with new fixtures or fix that leaky faucet. We install and repair all types of plumbing fixtures, including kitchen and bathroom faucets, toilets, garbage disposals, and showerheads. Our work is precise, ensuring no leaks and a perfect fit.
benefits: Wide selection of brands and styles

process.title: Consultation
process.description: Discuss your preferences and we’ll help you choose fixtures that match your style and budget.

process.title: Installation
process.description: We remove old fixtures and install new ones with care, ensuring proper sealing and alignment.

process.title: Quality Check
process.description: We test for leaks, check water pressure, and make sure everything operates smoothly.

faqs.question: Can you install a faucet I bought from a store?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can install any standard fixture, whether you provide it or we supply it.

faqs.question: How long does a toilet installation take?
faqs.answer: Typically 1-2 hours, depending on the complexity and any necessary adjustments.

about.headline: About Dallas Plumbing Pros Service
about.mission: Our mission is to provide Dallas homeowners and businesses with reliable, honest, and high-quality plumbing services. We believe in doing the job right the first time, with transparent pricing and exceptional customer care.
story: Dallas Plumbing Pros Service was founded by a team of master plumbers who saw a need for a more customer-focused plumbing company in the Dallas area. We started with a single truck and a commitment to punctuality, quality, and fair pricing. Over the years, we've grown into a trusted name, serving thousands of satisfied customers across the metroplex.

Our team continues to invest in the latest tools and training to stay ahead of industry changes. We're proud to be a locally owned and operated business that gives back to the community. Whether it's a minor repair or a major installation, we treat every job with the same dedication and professionalism.
